name: 2hongo
description: Search 2hongo's authenticated Japanese reference, play word recordings, and use the connected learner's study record for personalized practice.

interface.shortDescription: Trusted Japanese reference and personalized practice from 2hongo.
interface.longDescription: Search 2hongo's dictionary and grammar reference, retrieve its stored word and pattern details, and play its pronunciation recordings after connecting a free 2hongo account. For the signed-in learner it can also read their review workload, study plan, and learner profile; eligible accounts can derive recent progress patterns, have 2hongo select personalized practice with authored questions, check a text's readability against their record, tailor Japanese written for them to what they are learning, assess JLPT inventory coverage without predicting an exam result, and—with explicit consent—record structured correct-use or error signals without storing the learner's sentence; and every account can synchronize completed practice results. Generic Japanese teaching remains an account-free skill and is identified separately from 2hongo data.
interface.defaultPrompt: Search 2hongo for a Japanese word and show its stored details or pronunciation audio.
